title: Karn Ashur and the High Dunes
status: Proposed planning geometry. Fictional planar coordinates. No terrain edits applied.

base_map.axes: Blender +X east, +Y north; elevations are in metres before exaggeration.

proposed_features.description: Independent north-draining basin. Bay outlet west of Qasr Samir. Establish dry-season discharge before marking it perennial.
Lower river below the Karn Ashur basin. Connect the local outlet to the upper end of this trace when grading the replacement terrain. Trace finishes at the regional study boundary.
Seasonal southwestern channel and well settlements. Extension beyond the map crop remains provisional.

Grain road from the existing coastal harbor through the northern valleys, along the west foothills to the northwest freight gate. Reserve room for a low-grade local connection when replacing the cone.
Tie-in study corridor. Confirm a downhill grade from the new basin outlet before carving terrain.
Study polygon. Place irrigated fields selectively on low-gradient benches along actual canals.
Study polygon for the main farm belt and strings of villages.

regional.routing_basis: Three candidate flow traces sampled from the coarse height raster after depression filling. Check terrain grades, runoff and seasonality in the detailed terrain pass. Road is a sketched corridor, not a surveyed alignment.

city.local_axes: Kilometres relative to the anchor. +X east, +Y north.
city.local_to_blender_xy: Add each local axis in km multiplied by 1000/unit_m to the corresponding anchor Blender xy axis.
earthworks: Replace the isolated cone and closed ring layout with twin rock summits, a terraced basin, and a lower southern outlet.
Blend sandstone cliffs and foot dunes into the existing massif. Keep dunes out of the active crop belt.
Grade the northwestern caravan approach independently of the steep pilgrimage climb.
Reserve floodplain buffers and use gravity-fed irrigation. Set basin elevations after checking a continuous downhill outlet.
Use the western summit for the First Flame. Preserve Al-Mirah as a small spring shrine.
Build the visual miniature separately from the true-scale layout. The 3.2 km base grid requires a higher-resolution local patch.
